title: U.S., Israel may attack Iran post-elections. And, SpaceX and Tesla consider merging
description: The U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible post-elections attack on Iran, an anonymous source tells NPR. And, Elon Musk considers merging his companies SpaceX and Tesla.

title: Farm country has beef with Trump as midterms approach
description: President Trump's attempts to bring beef prices down has potentially backfired politically in several key states.

title: Trump merchandise stores are closing: 'He has peaked'
description: At least four Trump merchandise stores have closed this year. Store owners say with Trump in his final term, there isn't as much to fire up his consumer fan base and sales have softened.

title: Trump's redistricting gave Republicans a head start, now it goes to the voters
description: President Trump, seeking to reshape the voting map, prompted a rare wave of mid-decade redistricting that gave Republicans a boost for holding the House. But the voters will determine if it works.

title: High health costs squeeze workers, even if you have good insurance through a job
description: About 157 million Americans get their health insurance through work. A survey of employers shows a moderate price uptick this year, but workers still say health costs are a top concern.

title: Backlash from attack ad upends Ohio gubernatorial race
description: An ad from Republican Vivek Ramaswamy's campaign for governor shows his opponent's mother calling her a liar, amid accounts by Democrat Amy Acton of an abusive childhood.

title: Political communications expert discusses Vivek Ramaswamy's controversial ad
description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with political communications expert Jacob Neiheisel from the University of Buffalo about Vivek Ramaswamy's controversial ad.

title: AIPAC halts endorsements and direct contributions to candidates
description: The pro-Israel lobbying group and influential political funder announced it would no longer endorse candidates or give directly to campaigns. AIPAC's affiliated super PAC, though, will continue.

title: The Justice Department begins notifying counties where it wants to monitor elections
description: The department has long deployed election monitors, but the Trump administration's unprecedented steps to try to wrestle control over elections have led to new concerns about DOJ monitoring this year.

title: California gas prices have long plagued Democratic candidates. This year is different
description: Gas prices in California continue to be the highest in the nation, but the war in Iran has given California Democrats a rare opportunity to turn the tables on the issue.
